topic: Aspects of Political Life in the Hispanic World
subject: spanish

moments.title: Demoiselles d'Avignon
moments.body: Picasso's painting opens Cubism. He spends most of his life in France but identifies as Spanish.
moments.takeaway: Spanish modernism is partly Parisian by address.

moments.title: The Persistence of Memory
moments.body: Dali's melting clocks become the global emblem of Surrealism.

moments.title: Guernica
moments.body: Picasso paints Guernica for the Spanish Pavilion at the 1937 Paris International Exposition.
moments.takeaway: Spanish artists could refuse to live in Franco's Spain.

now.title: Spanish modernism now
now.body: Guernica returned to Spain in 1981 after Franco's death, now at the Reina Sofia.
now.open_questions: Which works should be returned and when?

reflection: Three Spanish artists shaped what 20th-century painting looked like.
